# Privacy Policy

## What we collect

This app collects only the data described here: your account email address
and basic usage data (pages visited, actions taken).

## How we use it

We use this data to operate, maintain, and improve the product, and to
communicate with you about your account.

## Sharing

We do not sell your data. We share it only with third-party service
providers (e.g. our hosting provider) strictly to operate the service.

## Retention

We retain account data for as long as your account remains active, and
delete it within 30 days of account closure.

## Your rights

You may access, correct, or request deletion of your data at any time by
contacting us, and you may opt-out of non-essential communications.
